# steps

1. sign in with the test account
2. if a cookie banner shows, accept only the necessary ones
3. press the book now button
4. choose the haircut and then the kids' cut, press continue
5. mark the second stylist as a favourite with the little heart icon
6. choose Mei as the stylist and continue
7. in the calendar go forward to the date three weeks from today and pick it
8. choose the second afternoon time
9. continue, then type the phone number 07700 900123 and tick the terms box
10. open the booking terms, then close that window again
11. if a special offer popup is showing, close it without signing up
12. now using only the keyboard, press tab until the continue button is focused and press enter
13. read out what the summary says about the price and the date
14. confirm the booking
15. close the confirmation
